name: [$] --- EcoCityCraft - Since 2011 --- [$]
description:
BEDROCK PLAYERS: Join mps.ecc.eco on port 19132.

EcoCityCraft is a Minecraft economy community with history since 2011. Build your fortune through player trade, jobs and shops, with Java and Bedrock players sharing the economy.

START YOUR ECONOMY

- Begin with /tutorial and check your EcoDollars with /balance.

- Open /jobsinfo, join a job and earn from its listed activities.

- Create a ChestShop from Builder rank in eligible Main locations where you have building permission. Set your buy and sell prices.

- Reach Resident, then apply for Mayor and your own protected town.

- Search ShopDB by item, town or merchant and follow directions to player shops.

Comparing Minecraft economy servers? Explore our gameplay, ranks, joining guide and world/reset information:

https://www.ecocitycraft.com/economy/

Find player shops: https://shopdb.ecocitycraft.com/

Community Discord: https://ecc.eco/discord
